Behind her is a dark blue wall with a white geometric line pattern. She speaks directly to the camera with high energy and active hand gestures. (2) A close-up shot of a small wooden bowl containing thick white yogurt being stirred by a small wooden spoon on a light grey surface scattered with brown grains. (3) A close-up shows a person in a grey tank top pouring white milk from a glass bottle into a clear drinking glass. (4) A bowl of creamy white yogurt topped with several red raspberries and a drizzle of honey is held in a hand; a wooden spoon scoops a portion out. (5) Back to the woman at the table, she continues her explanation, using wide hand motions to describe a large container. (6) A blonde woman is seen eating yogurt from a white plastic container using a spoon in an outdoor patio setting. (7) A carton of Whole Milk stands on a kitchen counter next to a glass measuring cup filled with milk. (8) A hand stirs a spoonful of yogurt into the milk within the measuring cup using a wooden spoon. (9) A series of quick cuts show a glass jar covered with a white cloth, a hand pressing the 'Proof' button on an Anova kitchen appliance, and a white Vermicular electric pot on a black base. (11) The woman returns to the screen, gesturing with her hands and counting points on her fingers. (12) A close-up of a pink bowl shows a spoonful of very thick, smooth yogurt being lifted, revealing a creamy texture. (13) The woman concludes her talk, pointing towards the viewer with a smile.
